blocks.text: This Meccan sûrah is a warning to Abu Lahab (lit., the Father of Flames), *who was an uncle of the Prophet (* صلى الله عليه وسلم *). Both Abu Lahab and his wife Um* *Jamîl used to abuse the Prophet (* صلى الله عليه وسلم *) and deny the One True God, Who is* *described in the next sûrah.*
In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful
The Fate of an Evil Couple
May the hands of Abu Lahab perish, and he ˹himself˺ perish!
Neither his wealth nor ˹worldly˺ gains will benefit him.
He will burn in a flaming Fire,
and ˹so will˺ his wife, the carrier of ˹thorny˺ kindling, [1333]
around her neck will be a rope of palm-fibre.[1334]
